gruss_morgen.text: Stop! Don't move! The morning light on your ear — that is a SUBJECT! ... Too late, it's gone. Good morning.

gruss_tag.text: Knips! Photographer, artist, hunter of the perfect moment! The perfect moment usually flees. Like everything from foxes.

gruss_abend.text: The golden hour! Everything looks dipped in honey! I took 400 photos. Of a fence post. It wears the light FANTASTICALLY.

gruss_regen.text: Rain! Reflections! Drama! The puddles are mirrors today and the whole ranch exists twice! TWO subjects for the price of one!

gruss_freund.text: My favorite subject on two legs! Did you know you look better from the left? From the right too, though. It's confusingly good.

text: Today: a chicken on final approach to the feed trough. Wings wide, gaze determined. I call it: The Eagle.
The chicken insists on the title. We're still negotiating the image rights. It wants grains.
I'm working on a series: The Ranch Awakens. Your farm is doing marvelously in it, honestly.
My best series before that: The Fence In Weather. Six hundred pictures. No buyer. PHILISTINES.
Between us artists: the best pictures happen when nobody poses. That's why I mostly photograph you secretly.
That came out wrong. I mean: artistically secretly. With respect and a telephoto lens. Hm. Not better.

quest_vergabe.text: Yes! An assignment! Art needs you! More precisely: art needs your legs, mine are short.

quest_annahme.text: WONDERFUL! And remember: should something magnificent happen along the way — FACE TO THE SUN!

ablehnung.text: I understand. One does not force the muse. One waits until she passes by and then photographs her very quickly.

quest_abgabe.text: PERFECT! Wait — hold that pose! The pride on your face! CLICK! That goes in the exhibition. Here, your fee!

geschenk_liebt.text: Berries! The COLOR! That red! I must photograph them first, then eat them! Still life with berries, then still life without berries!

geschenk_mag.text: Oh, thank you! Very photogenic! Almost as photogenic as the fence post. From me, that is a HUGE compliment.

geschenk_normal.text: Interesting texture. Difficult light. I accept it — as an artistic challenge. And because you're nice.

text: My best photo? A wild horse in the morning mist, up on the hill. Just a shadow with a mane.
I waited in a bush for three weeks. A hedgehog mistook me for a larger, dumber bush.
When the picture was done, I cried. So did the hedgehog. We were a good team.
The photo I'm missing? It sounds crazy: the whole ranch. Everyone. At one table. At the festival.
Rosi, laughing. Ironhoof, almost smiling. Timmi, sitting still — fine, that one will be a long exposure.
One day you'll make that festival happen, I can feel it. And me? I'll be ready. With a clean lens.

tschuess.text: Good light! And if you see a rainbow anywhere: report IMMEDIATELY. That is an EMERGENCY.
